section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of actual bra size in a Brazilian study (N = 194) as a proxy for breast size, following standardized national benchmarks. Table 1 presents inter-scale correlations between breast size dissatisfaction and other variables including body appreciation (BAS), weight discrepancy, body areas satisfaction, sociocultural attitudes, and body mass index. The correlation between body appreciation and BMI is -0.36 (p < .05).

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of actual bra size in a study with N=100 participants, where trained researchers measured bra size following Brazilian national reference benchmarks. Table 2 presents mean ratings and standard deviations for BSRS-derived scores (current breast size, ideal breast size, breast size dissatisfaction, and absolute breast size dissatisfaction) along with intraclass correlation coefficients between test and retest, all showing high reliability (correlations ranging from .83 to .96, p < .001).
